value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: A line can be confirmed at most at the quantity it was ordered with.

PiecesNotAllowed.summary: Pieces sent on a line that was not created with product.unit

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: Pieces can be sent only on a line created with 'Product.Unit'.

PiecesCountMismatch.summary: The pieces sent are not as many as the quantity delivered

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: Send one piece per unit delivered: 'Pieces' must have 'Quantity' items.

MarginNotConfirmable.summary: The preauthorization margin was sent with a quantity above zero

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The preauthorization margin is released at confirmation: send it with quantity 0, or leave it out.

value.title: One or more validation errors occurred.
value.detail: You should provide a well formatted CustomerId.

422.description: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts. Unless `operations` lists something, no transaction was touched.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. It remains consistent across occurrences of the same error type.

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

RefundRequired.summary: Confirming would give back money already captured, and no RefundMode allows it

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: Confirming at these amounts gives back money already captured. Specify a RefundMode to allow it.

LinesMismatch.summary: A line of the Payment is missing from `lines`, or one sent matches none

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: A line of the Payment is missing. Send every line, with quantity 0 for the ones not delivered.

InvalidAmount.summary: Nothing was delivered, so there is nothing to confirm

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The confirmed amount must be greater than zero. To give back the whole Payment, refund it.

AmountExceedsPaid.summary: The amount is higher than what the transactions can cover

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The confirmed amount is higher than what the customer paid, or than what can be paid outside meal vouchers.

CaptureBelowMinimum.summary: The amount left on an authorization is under the minimum the gateway captures

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The amount left to capture is below the minimum amount of the payment gateway.

CannotAllocate.summary: No split of the amounts across the transactions of the Payment adds up

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The confirmed amounts can't be split across the transactions of the Payment.

ImpossiblePartialRefund.summary: The gateway can't refund that amount partially, by configuration or by its own answer

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The payment gateway can't refund this amount partially. You can confirm with RefundMode 'Credit' or 'GatewayOrCredit'.

ImpossibleRefund.summary: The gateway refused the refund, after the captures were already done

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The payment gateway refused to refund the transaction. You can confirm with RefundMode 'Credit' or 'GatewayOrCredit'.

InsufficientFunds.summary: The gateway account has not enough balance to refund

value.title: The Payment can't be confirmed at the requested amounts.
value.detail: The transaction can't be refunded due to insufficient funds on your payment gateway account.

424.description: A payment gateway failed. `operations` lists what was already done; sending the same request again settles what is left.
